data.why: the repository ships example_data.csv and the interface has a built-in 'Load Example' button that loads it directly, so no synthetic data is needed.

goals: upload a daily discharge/rainfall time series and review summary statistics and outliers before analysis
fit candidate probability distributions (e.g. Normal, Log Normal, Gumbel, Log Pearson III) to the series
run frequency analysis to estimate return-period magnitudes (e.g. 2, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100-year events)
evaluate goodness-of-fit (e.g. Chi-Square, Smirnov-Kolmogorov) to choose the best-fitting distribution
download the computed frequency-analysis and goodness-of-fit results as CSV for reporting

review.summary: This is a well-grounded tree: it follows the README's four-stage workflow exactly, uses neutral general labels and faithful specific ones, and every screen I sampled matches its node. The one gap is the step the goal itself names, actually choosing the best-fitting distribution from the combined test results, which should be added before filing.
